verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹשׁ לְמַלְכ֖וּת בֵּלְאשַׁצַּ֣ר הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ חָז֞וֹן נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל אַחֲרֵ֛י הַנִּרְאָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י בַּתְּחִלָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šā·lō·wōš lə·mal·ḵūṯ bê·lə·šaṣ·ṣar ham·me·leḵ ḥā·zō·wn nir·’āh ’ê·lay ’ă·nî ḏā·nî·yêl ’a·ḥă·rê han·nir·’āh ’ê·lay bat·tə·ḥil·lāh
verses.literal: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar a vision appeared to me . . . Daniel subsequent to the one that had appeared to me earlier
verses.literalPt: NO ano terceiro do reinado do rei Belsazar apareceu-me uma visão, a mim, Daniel, depois daquela que me apareceu no princípio.

verses.original: וָֽאֶרְאֶה֮ בֶּחָזוֹן֒ וַיְהִי֙ בִּרְאֹתִ֔י וַאֲנִי֙ בְּשׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַבִּירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵילָ֣ם הַמְּדִינָ֑ה וָאֶרְאֶה֙ בֶּֽחָז֔וֹן וַאֲנִ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי עַל־ אוּבַ֥ל אוּלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’er·’eh be·ḥā·zō·wn way·hî bir·’ō·ṯî wa·’ă·nî bə·šū·šan hab·bî·rāh ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·lām ham·mə·ḏî·nāh wā·’er·’eh be·ḥā·zō·wn wa·’ă·nî hā·yî·ṯî ‘al- ’ū·ḇal ’ū·lāy
verses.literal: And in the vision I saw myself in the citadel of Susa in the province of Elam I saw in the vision that I was beside the Ulai Canal
verses.literalPt: E vi na visão; e sucedeu que, quando vi, eu estava na cidadela de Susã, na província de Elão; vi, pois, na visão, que eu estava junto ao rio Ulai.

verses.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ וָאֶרְאֶ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֗ד עֹמֵ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֻבָ֖ל וְל֣וֹ קְרָנָ֑יִם וְהַקְּרָנַ֣יִם גְּבֹה֗וֹת וְהָאַחַת֙ גְּבֹהָ֣ה מִן־ הַשֵּׁנִ֔ית וְהַ֨גְּבֹהָ֔ה עֹלָ֖ה בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eś·śā ‘ê·nay wā·’er·’eh wə·hin·nêh ’a·yil ’e·ḥāḏ ‘ō·mêḏ lip̄·nê hā·’u·ḇāl wə·lōw qə·rā·nā·yim wə·haq·qə·rā·na·yim gə·ḇō·hō·wṯ wə·hā·’a·ḥaṯ gə·ḇō·hāh min- haš·šê·nîṯ wə·hag·gə·ḇō·hāh ‘ō·lāh bā·’a·ḥă·rō·nāh
verses.literal: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw - a ram with two horns standing beside the canal The horns were long but one was longer than the other and the longer one grew up later
verses.literalPt: E levantei os meus olhos, e vi, e eis que um carneiro estava diante do rio, o qual tinha dois chifres; e os dois chifres eram altos, mas um era mais alto do que o outro; e o mais alto subiu por último.

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתִי אֶת־ הָאַ֡יִל מְנַגֵּחַ֩ יָ֨מָּה וְצָפ֜וֹנָה וָנֶ֗גְבָּה וְכָל־ חַיּוֹת֙ לֹֽא־ יַֽעַמְד֣וּ לְפָנָ֔יו וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּ֖יל מִיָּד֑וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה כִרְצֹנ֖וֹ וְהִגְדִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- hā·’a·yil mə·nag·gê·aḥ yām·māh wə·ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh wā·neḡ·bāh wə·ḵāl ḥay·yō·wṯ lō- ya·‘am·ḏū lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl mî·yā·ḏōw wə·‘ā·śāh ḵir·ṣō·nōw wə·hiḡ·dîl
verses.literal: I saw the ram charging toward the west and the north and the south No . . . animal could stand against him and there was no deliverance from his power He did as he pleased and became great
verses.literalPt: Vi que o carneiro dava marradas para o ocidente, e para o norte e para o sul; e nenhum dos animais lhe podia resistir; nem havia quem pudesse livrar-se da sua mão; e ele fazia conforme a sua vontade, e se engrandecia.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י׀ הָיִ֣יתִי מֵבִ֗ין וְהִנֵּ֤ה צְפִיר־ הָֽעִזִּים֙ בָּ֤א מִן־ הַֽמַּעֲרָב֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין נוֹגֵ֖עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהַ֨צָּפִ֔יר קֶ֥רֶן חָז֖וּת בֵּ֥ין עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî hā·yî·ṯî mê·ḇîn wə·hin·nêh ṣə·p̄îr- hā·‘iz·zîm bā min- ham·ma·‘ă·rāḇ ‘al- pə·nê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’ên nō·w·ḡê·a‘ bā·’ā·reṣ wə·haṣ·ṣā·p̄îr qe·ren ḥā·zūṯ bên ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: As I was contemplating all this suddenly a goat with a prominent horn between his eyes . . . came out of the west crossing the surface of the entire earth without touching the ground
verses.literalPt: E, estando eu considerando, eis que um bode vinha do ocidente sobre toda a terra, mas sem tocar no chão; e aquele bode tinha um chifre insigne entre os olhos.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗א עַד־ הָאַ֙יִל֙ בַּ֣עַל הַקְּרָנַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֔יתִי עֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י הָאֻבָ֑ל וַיָּ֥רָץ אֵלָ֖יו בַּחֲמַ֥ת כֹּחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ‘aḏ- hā·’a·yil ba·‘al haq·qə·rā·na·yim ’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯî ‘ō·mêḏ lip̄·nê hā·’u·ḇāl way·yā·rāṣ ’ê·lāw ba·ḥă·maṯ kō·ḥōw
verses.literal: He came toward the two-horned ram . . . I had seen standing beside the canal and rushed at him with furious power
verses.literalPt: E dirigiu-se ao carneiro que tinha os dois chifres, ao qual eu tinha visto em pé diante do rio, e correu contra ele no ímpeto da sua força.

verses.original: וּרְאִיתִ֞יו מַגִּ֣יעַ׀ אֵ֣צֶל הָאַ֗יִל וַיִּתְמַרְמַ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־ הָאַ֔יִל וַיְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֣י קְרָנָ֔יו וְלֹא־ הָ֥יָה כֹ֛חַ בָּאַ֖יִל לַעֲמֹ֣ד לְפָנָ֑יו וַיַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤הוּ אַ֙רְצָה֙ וַֽיִּרְמְסֵ֔הוּ וְלֹא־ הָיָ֥ה מַצִּ֛יל לָאַ֖יִל מִיָּדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·’î·ṯîw mag·gî·a‘ ’ê·ṣel hā·’a·yil way·yiṯ·mar·mar ’ê·lāw way·yaḵ ’eṯ- hā·’a·yil way·šab·bêr ’eṯ- šə·tê qə·rā·nāw wə·lō- hā·yāh ḵō·aḥ bā·’a·yil la·‘ă·mōḏ lə·p̄ā·nāw way·yaš·lî·ḵê·hū ’ar·ṣāh way·yir·mə·sê·hū wə·lō- hā·yāh maṣ·ṣîl lā·’a·yil mî·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: I saw him approach . . . the ram in a rage against him and he struck the ram and shattered his two horns The ram was powerless to stand against him and the goat threw him to the ground and trampled him and no one could deliver the ram from his power
verses.literalPt: E vi-o chegar perto do carneiro, enfurecido contra ele, e ferindo-o quebrou-lhe os dois chifres, pois não havia força no carneiro para lhe resistir, e o bode o lançou por terra, e o pisou aos pés; não houve quem pudesse livrar o carneiro da sua mão.

verses.original: וּצְפִ֥יר הָעִזִּ֖ים הִגְדִּ֣יל עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד וּכְעָצְמ֗וֹ נִשְׁבְּרָה֙ הַקֶּ֣רֶן הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה וַֽתַּעֲלֶ֜נָה חָז֤וּת אַרְבַּע֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ לְאַרְבַּ֖ע רוּח֥וֹת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·p̄îr hā·‘iz·zîm hiḡ·dîl ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ ū·ḵə·‘ā·ṣə·mōw niš·bə·rāh haq·qe·ren hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh wat·ta·‘ă·le·nāh ḥā·zūṯ ’ar·ba‘ taḥ·te·hā lə·’ar·ba‘ rū·ḥō·wṯ haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Thus the goat . . . became very great but at the height of his power his large horn was broken off and four prominent horns came up in its place pointing toward the four winds of heaven
verses.literalPt: E o bode se engrandeceu sobremaneira; mas, estando na sua maior força, aquele grande chifre foi quebrado; e no seu lugar subiram outros quatro também insignes, para os quatro ventos do céu.

verses.original: וּמִן־ הָאַחַ֣ת מֵהֶ֔ם יָצָ֥א קֶֽרֶן־ אַחַ֖ת מִצְּעִירָ֑ה וַתִּגְדַּל־ יֶ֛תֶר אֶל־ הַנֶּ֥גֶב וְאֶל־ הַמִּזְרָ֖ח וְאֶל־ הַצֶּֽבִי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- hā·’a·ḥaṯ mê·hem yā·ṣā qe·ren- ’a·ḥaṯ miṣ·ṣə·‘î·rāh wat·tiḡ·dal- ye·ṯer ’el- han·ne·ḡeḇ wə·’el- ham·miz·rāḥ wə·’el- haṣ·ṣe·ḇî
verses.literal: From one of these horns a little horn emerged and grew extensively toward the south and the east . . . and toward the Beautiful Land
verses.literalPt: E de um deles saiu um chifre muito pequeno, o qual cresceu muito para o sul, e para o oriente, e para a terra formosa.

verses.original: וַתִּגְדַּ֖ל עַד־ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַתַּפֵּ֥ל אַ֛רְצָה מִן־ הַצָּבָ֥א וּמִן־ הַכּוֹכָבִ֖ים וַֽתִּרְמְסֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḡ·dal ‘aḏ- ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·mā·yim wat·tap·pêl ’ar·ṣāh min- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā ū·min- hak·kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm wat·tir·mə·sêm
verses.literal: It grew as high as the host of heaven and it cast down some of the host and some of the stars to the earth and trampled them
verses.literalPt: E se engrandeceu até contra o exército do céu; e a alguns do exército, e das estrelas, lançou por terra, e os pisou.

verses.original: וְעַ֥ד שַֽׂר־ הַצָּבָ֖א הִגְדִּ֑יל וּמִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ הֵרִים הַתָּמִ֔יד וְהֻשְׁלַ֖ךְ מְכ֥וֹן מִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘aḏ śar- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā hiḡ·dîl ū·mim·men·nū hē·rīm hat·tā·mîḏ wə·huš·laḵ mə·ḵō·wn miq·dā·šōw
verses.literal: It magnified itself . . . even to the Prince of the host it removed His daily sacrifice and overthrew the place of His sanctuary
verses.literalPt: E se engrandeceu até contra o príncipe do exército; e por ele foi tirado o sacrifício contínuo, e o lugar do seu santuário foi lançado por terra.

verses.original: וְצָבָ֛א תִּנָּתֵ֥ן עַל־ הַתָּמִ֖יד בְּפָ֑שַׁע וְתַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ אֱמֶת֙ אַ֔רְצָה וְעָשְׂתָ֖ה וְהִצְלִֽיחָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣā·ḇā tin·nā·ṯên ‘al- hat·tā·mîḏ bə·p̄ā·ša‘ wə·ṯaš·lêḵ ’ĕ·meṯ ’ar·ṣāh wə·‘ā·śə·ṯāh wə·hiṣ·lî·ḥāh
verses.literal: And in the rebellion the host and the daily sacrifice were given over to the horn and it flung truth to the ground and prospered in whatever it did
verses.literalPt: E um exército foi dado contra o sacrifício contínuo, por causa da transgressão; e lançou a verdade por terra, e o fez, e prosperou.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמְעָ֥ה אֶֽחָד־ קָד֖וֹשׁ מְדַבֵּ֑ר וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֶחָ֨ד קָד֜וֹשׁ לַפַּֽלְמוֹנִ֣י הַֽמְדַבֵּ֗ר עַד־ מָתַ֞י הֶחָז֤וֹן הַתָּמִיד֙ וְהַפֶּ֣שַׁע שֹׁמֵ֔ם תֵּ֛ת וְקֹ֥דֶשׁ וְצָבָ֖א מִרְמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·mə·‘āh ’e·ḥāḏ- qā·ḏō·wōš mə·ḏab·bêr way·yō·mer ’e·ḥāḏ qā·ḏō·wōš lap·pal·mō·w·nî ham·ḏab·bêr ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay he·ḥā·zō·wn hat·tā·mîḏ wə·hap·pe·ša‘ šō·mêm têṯ wə·qō·ḏeš wə·ṣā·ḇā mir·mās
verses.literal: Then I heard a holy one speaking and another holy . . . one said to him How long until the fulfillment of the vision of the daily sacrifice the rebellion that causes desolation and the surrender of the sanctuary and of the host to be trampled
verses.literalPt: Depois ouvi um santo que falava; e disse outro santo àquele que falava: Até quando durará a visão do sacrifício contínuo, e da transgressão assoladora, para que sejam entregues o santuário e o exército, a fim de serem pisados?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י עַ֚ד עֶ֣רֶב בֹּ֔קֶר אַלְפַּ֖יִם וּשְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וְנִצְדַּ֖ק קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ‘aḏ ‘e·reḇ bō·qer ’al·pa·yim ū·šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ wə·niṣ·daq qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: He said to me It will take 2,300 . . . . . . evenings and mornings then the sanctuary will be properly restored
verses.literalPt: E ele me disse: Até duas mil e trezentas tardes e manhãs; e o santuário será purificado.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּרְאֹתִ֛י אֲנִ֥י דָנִיֵּ֖אל אֶת־ הֶחָז֑וֹן וָאֲבַקְשָׁ֣ה בִינָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד לְנֶגְדִּ֖י כְּמַרְאֵה־ גָֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bir·’ō·ṯî ’ă·nî ḏā·nî·yêl ’eṯ- he·ḥā·zō·wn wā·’ă·ḇaq·šāh ḇî·nāh wə·hin·nêh ‘ō·mêḏ lə·neḡ·dî kə·mar·’êh- ḡā·ḇer
verses.literal: While I Daniel was watching the vision and trying to understand it there stood before me one having the appearance of a man
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, havendo eu, Daniel, tido a visão, procurei o significado, e eis que se apresentou diante de mim como que uma semelhança de homem.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹל־ אָדָ֖ם בֵּ֣ין אוּלָ֑י וַיִּקְרָא֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר גַּבְרִיאֵ֕ל הָבֵ֥ן לְהַלָּ֖ז אֶת־ הַמַּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·ma‘ qō·wl- ’ā·ḏām bên ’ū·lāy way·yiq·rā way·yō·mar gaḇ·rî·’êl hā·ḇên lə·hal·lāz ’eṯ- ham·mar·’eh
verses.literal: And I heard the voice of a man calling . . . from between the banks of the Ulai Gabriel explain the vision to this man
verses.literalPt: E ouvi uma voz de homem entre as margens do Ulai, a qual gritou, e disse: Gabriel, dá a entender a este a visão.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֵ֣צֶל עָמְדִ֔י וּבְבֹא֣וֹ נִבְעַ֔תִּי וָאֶפְּלָ֖ה עַל־ פָּנָ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ הָבֵ֣ן בֶּן־ אָדָ֔ם כִּ֖י לְעֶת־ קֵ֥ץ הֶחָזֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’ê·ṣel ‘ā·mə·ḏî ū·ḇə·ḇō·’ōw niḇ·‘at·tî wā·’ep·pə·lāh ‘al- pā·nāy way·yō·mer ’ê·lay hā·ḇên ben- ’ā·ḏām kî lə·‘eṯ- qêṣ he·ḥā·zō·wn
verses.literal: As he came near to where I stood I was terrified and fell facedown . . . Son of man he said to me understand that the vision concerns the time of the end
verses.literalPt: E veio perto de onde eu estava; e, vindo ele, me amedrontei, e caí sobre o meu rosto; mas ele me disse: Entende, filho do homem, porque esta visão acontecerá no fim do tempo.

verses.original: וּבְדַבְּר֣וֹ עִמִּ֔י נִרְדַּ֥מְתִּי עַל־ פָּנַ֖י אָ֑רְצָה וַיִּ֨גַּע־ בִּ֔י וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵ֖נִי עַל־ עָמְדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḏab·bə·rōw ‘im·mî nir·dam·tî ‘al- pā·nay ’ā·rə·ṣāh way·yig·ga‘- bî way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏê·nî ‘al- ‘ā·mə·ḏî
verses.literal: While he was speaking with me I fell into a deep sleep with my face to the ground Then he touched me helped me to my feet . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E, estando ele falando comigo, caí adormecido com o rosto em terra; ele, porém, me tocou, e me fez estar em pé.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִנְנִ֣י מוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֔ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַזָּ֑עַם כִּ֖י לְמוֹעֵ֥ד קֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hin·nî mō·w·ḏî·‘ă·ḵā ’êṯ ’ă·šer- yih·yeh bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ haz·zā·‘am kî lə·mō·w·‘êḏ qêṣ
verses.literal: and said Behold I will make known to you what will happen in the latter time of wrath because it concerns the appointed time of the end
verses.literalPt: E disse: Eis que te farei saber o que há de acontecer no último tempo da ira; pois isso pertence ao tempo determinado do fim.

verses.original: הָאַ֥יִל אֲשֶׁר־ רָאִ֖יתָ בַּ֣עַל הַקְּרָנָ֑יִם מַלְכֵ֖י מָדַ֥י וּפָרָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’a·yil ’ă·šer- rā·’î·ṯā ba·‘al haq·qə·rā·nā·yim mal·ḵê mā·ḏay ū·p̄ā·rās
verses.literal: The two-horned ram that you saw . . . represents the kings of Media and Persia
verses.literalPt: Aquele carneiro que viste com dois chifres são os reis da Média e da Pérsia,

verses.original: וְהַצָּפִ֥יר הַשָּׂעִ֖יר מֶ֣לֶךְ יָוָ֑ן וְהַקֶּ֤רֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּין־ עֵינָ֔יו ה֖וּא הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haṣ·ṣā·p̄îr haś·śā·‘îr me·leḵ yā·wān wə·haq·qe·ren hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh ’ă·šer bên- ‘ê·nāw hū ham·me·leḵ hā·ri·šō·wn
verses.literal: The shaggy goat represents the king of Greece and the large horn between his eyes is the first king
verses.literalPt: Mas o bode peludo é o rei da Grécia; e o grande chifre que tinha entre os olhos é o primeiro rei;

verses.original: וְהַ֨נִּשְׁבֶּ֔רֶת וַתַּֽעֲמֹ֥דְנָה אַרְבַּ֖ע תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ אַרְבַּ֧ע מַלְכֻי֛וֹת מִגּ֥וֹי יַעֲמֹ֖דְנָה וְלֹ֥א בְכֹחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·niš·be·reṯ wat·ta·‘ă·mō·ḏə·nāh ’ar·ba‘ taḥ·te·hā ’ar·ba‘ mal·ḵu·yō·wṯ mig·gō·w ya·‘ă·mō·ḏə·nāh wə·lō ḇə·ḵō·ḥōw
verses.literal: The four horns that replaced the broken one represent four kingdoms that will rise from that nation . . . but will not have the same power
verses.literalPt: O ter sido quebrado, levantando-se quatro em lugar dele, significa que quatro reinos se levantarão da mesma nação, mas não com a força dele.

verses.original: וּֽבְאַחֲרִית֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔ם כְּהָתֵ֖ם הַפֹּשְׁעִ֑ים יַעֲמֹ֛ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עַז־ פָּנִ֖ים וּמֵבִ֥ין חִידֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ mal·ḵū·ṯām kə·hā·ṯêm hap·pō·šə·‘îm ya·‘ă·mōḏ me·leḵ ‘az- pā·nîm ū·mê·ḇîn ḥî·ḏō·wṯ
verses.literal: In the latter part of their reign when the rebellion has reached its full measure an insolent . . . king skilled in intrigue will come to the throne
verses.literalPt: Mas, no fim do seu reinado, quando acabarem os prevaricadores, se levantará um rei, feroz de semblante, e será entendido em adivinhações.

verses.original: וְעָצַ֤ם כֹּחוֹ֙ וְלֹ֣א בְכֹח֔וֹ וְנִפְלָא֥וֹת יַשְׁחִ֖ית וְהִצְלִ֣יחַ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וְהִשְׁחִ֥ית עֲצוּמִ֖ים וְעַם־ קְדֹשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ṣam kō·ḥōw wə·lō ḇə·ḵō·ḥōw wə·nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ yaš·ḥîṯ wə·hiṣ·lî·aḥ wə·‘ā·śāh wə·hiš·ḥîṯ ‘ă·ṣū·mîm wə·‘am- qə·ḏō·šîm
verses.literal: His power will be great but it . . . will not be his own He will cause terrible destruction and succeed in whatever he does He will destroy the mighty men along with the holy people
verses.literalPt: E se fortalecerá o seu poder, mas não pela sua própria força; e destruirá maravilhosamente, e prosperará, e fará o que lhe aprouver; e destruirá os poderosos e o povo santo.

verses.original: וְעַל־ שִׂכְל֗וֹ וְהִצְלִ֤יחַ מִרְמָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וּבִלְבָב֣וֹ יַגְדִּ֔יל וּבְשַׁלְוָ֖ה יַשְׁחִ֣ית רַבִּ֑ים וְעַ֤ל־ שַׂר־ שָׂרִים֙ יַעֲמֹ֔ד וּבְאֶ֥פֶס יָ֖ד יִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- śiḵ·lōw wə·hiṣ·lî·aḥ mir·māh bə·yā·ḏōw ū·ḇil·ḇā·ḇōw yaḡ·dîl ū·ḇə·šal·wāh yaš·ḥîṯ rab·bîm wə·‘al- śar- śā·rîm ya·‘ă·mōḏ ū·ḇə·’e·p̄es yāḏ yiš·šā·ḇêr
verses.literal: Through his craft and by his hand he will cause deceit to prosper and in his own mind he will make himself great In a time of peace he will destroy many and he will even stand against the Prince of princes Yet he will be broken off but not by human hands
verses.literalPt: E pelo seu entendimento também fará prosperar o engano na sua mão; e no seu coração se engrandecerá, e destruirá a muitos que vivem em segurança; e se levantará contra o Príncipe dos príncipes, mas sem mão será quebrado.

verses.original: וּמַרְאֵ֨ה הָעֶ֧רֶב וְהַבֹּ֛קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶאֱמַ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת ה֑וּא וְאַתָּה֙ סְתֹ֣ם הֶֽחָז֔וֹן כִּ֖י לְיָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mar·’êh hā·‘e·reḇ wə·hab·bō·qer ’ă·šer ne·’ĕ·mar ’ĕ·meṯ hū wə·’at·tāh sə·ṯōm he·ḥā·zō·wn kî lə·yā·mîm rab·bîm
verses.literal: The vision of the evenings and the mornings that has been spoken is true . . . Now you must seal up the vision for it concerns the distant future
verses.literalPt: E a visão da tarde e da manhã que foi falada, é verdadeira. Tu, porém, cerra a visão, porque se refere a dias muito distantes.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֗אל נִהְיֵ֤יתִי וְנֶֽחֱלֵ֙יתִי֙ יָמִ֔ים וָאָק֕וּם וָאֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה אֶת־ מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וָאֶשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם עַל־ הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין מֵבִֽין׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ḏā·nî·yêl nih·yê·ṯî wə·ne·ḥĕ·lê·ṯî yā·mîm wā·’ā·qūm wā·’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’eṯ- mə·le·ḵeṯ ham·me·leḵ wā·’eš·tō·w·mêm ‘al- ham·mar·’eh wə·’ên mê·ḇîn
verses.literal: I Daniel was exhausted and lay ill for days Then I got up and went about the king’s business I was confounded by the vision it was beyond understanding
verses.literalPt: E eu, Daniel, enfraqueci, e estive enfermo alguns dias; então levantei-me e tratei do negócio do rei. E espantei-me acerca da visão, e não havia quem a entendesse.
